description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants for configuring and managing PDCCH search spaces in 5G NR, including SearchSpace IDs, types, and configurations as per 3GPP TS 38.331.

classes.name: search_space_configuration
classes.description: Represents configuration parameters for a PDCCH search space, including ID, CORESET, DCI formats, monitoring symbols, and timing details.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two search_space_configuration instances.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the SearchSpace ID.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_id
methods.description: Sets the ID for non-SearchSpace#0 instances.

methods.name: get_coreset_id
methods.description: Returns the associated CORESET ID.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_coreset_id
methods.description: Sets the CORESET ID for non-SearchSpace#0 instances.

methods.name: is_search_space0
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is for SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: is_common_search_space
methods.description: Checks if the search space is common or UE-specific.

methods.name: get_ss0_index
methods.description: Returns the index of SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_nof_candidates
methods.description: Sets the number of PDCCH candidates for non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_nof_candidates
methods.description: Returns the number of candidates.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitored_dci_formats
methods.description: Sets the DCI formats monitored in non-SearchSpace#0.

methods.name: get_monitored_dci_formats
methods.description: Returns the monitored DCI formats.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_slot_periodicity
methods.description: Sets the periodicity in slots for monitoring.

methods.name: get_monitoring_slot_periodicity
methods.description: Returns the monitoring periodicity.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_slot_offset
methods.description: Sets the slot offset for monitoring.

methods.name: get_monitoring_slot_offset
methods.description: Returns the slot offset.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_duration
methods.description: Sets the duration in slots for the search space.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in slots.

methods.name: set_non_ss0_monitoring_symbols_within_slot
methods.description: Sets the monitoring symbols within a slot.

methods.name: get_monitoring_symbols_within_slot
methods.description: Returns the monitoring symbols within a slot.

methods.name: get_first_symbol_index
methods.description: Returns the first symbol index for monitoring.
